root.label: AIPAC spending in Michigan Democratic Senate primary

events.label: AIPAC spending in Michigan Democratic Senate primary

slots.name: Stevens ad spending
slots.sentence: Representative Haley Stevens, the moderate establishment-backed candidate, benefited from about $62 million in advertising spending from half a dozen outside groups.

slots.name: spending advantage
slots.sentence: That spending gave her and her allies about a 9-to-1 spending advantage over her progressive rival, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, and his allies, according to data from the media tracking firm AdImpact.

slots.name: debate opening minutes
slots.sentence: Last week, at the final debate , the two candidates spent much of the first 15 minutes in a searing fight about super PACs, advertising trends and dark-money nonprofit groups with undisclosed donors.

slots.name: UDP ad spending
slots.sentence: In his own much more limited advertising, including a closing spot featuring Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez of New York, Dr. El-Sayed has called for less money in politics.
